params.body:
The README, read against the code. Only stale claims corrected and missing essentials added; language and structure kept. Every change with the file and line that justifies it:

Review of README.md against Hoet-design/cabrio-eyewear-mirror (HEAD 48efc85).

- Intro: added that the iframe `src` is set after `load` by `mirror.js`, with a `<noscript>` fallback. Source: `mirror.js` lines 8-11; `index.html` lines 145-156 (`data-src`, `<noscript>` iframe, `<script src="mirror.js" defer>`).
- Files, `index.html`: added meta and Open Graph tags. Source: `index.html` lines 12-25 (description, og:*, twitter:card).
- Files: added `mirror.js`. Missing from README. Source: `mirror.js`; `index.html` lines 151-156 explain it moved out because the CSP refuses inline scripts.
- Files: added `_headers` with its header set. Missing from README. Source: `_headers` lines 4-9 (Cache-Control), line 27 (Content-Security-Policy), line 37 (Permissions-Policy), line 39 (X-Content-Type-Options), line 42 (Referrer-Policy); lines 22-25 on the blocked Google Fonts link.
- Files: added `share.png` (1200x630 OG image). Missing from README. Source: `index.html` lines 22-24 (og:image, width 1200, height 630); file present in repo root.
- Files: added `robots.txt` and `sitemap.xml`. Missing from README. Source: `robots.txt` lines 4-7; `sitemap.xml` (single `<url>`, comment on no `lastmod`).
- Files: added `elixir.json` and `.github/workflows/evidence.yml`. Missing from README. Source: both files present in repo.
- Deploy: "host the three files anywhere" is stale. The repo has more than three served files, and `_headers` is a Netlify-specific format that other hosts ignore. Source: `_headers` line 1 ("Netlify serveert standaard ..."); `.gitignore` lines 4-5 (Netlify CLI working folder); `index.html` lines 5-11 (Netlify sends the content-type header). Rewritten to say Netlify and that headers need the host's own means elsewhere.
- Deploy: added how to run locally and that there is no build, manifest or tests. Missing from README. Source: repo root has no package.json, composer.json, or test folder (`ls -la`).
- New section "Environments and monitoring": `elixir.json` declares only `production` at `https://cabrio-eyewear-mirror.com`; no `/up`, `/api/elixir` or `/.well-known/build.json` exist (static site, no backend). Source: `elixir.json` lines 1-5; repo file list.
- New section "CI": `evidence.yml` runs on `pull_request` to `main`, only when `github.head_ref` starts with `elixir/`, using `abovebeyond-ai/control-verify-action@v1` with `mode: pull`; no secret; no other workflow. Source: `.github/workflows/evidence.yml` lines 1-19; `.github/workflows/` contains only this file.
- Left as is: the description of the page (black header, white logo, full-height iframe, camera access) and the domain. Source: `index.html` lines 66-69 (header black/white), 115-119 (iframe height), 146 (`allow="microphone; camera"`); `elixir.json` line 3.
- Existing em dashes in the unchanged `index.html` and `logo-white.svg` bullets were left untouched (no style rewrite); new lines use colons.

Proposed through the control gateway under #agent-workbench.
